title: Functional-prior-based approaches to Bayesian PDE-constrained inversion using physics-informed neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.07060v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving PDE-constrained inverse problems, but their extension to Bayesian inversion still faces a fundamental difficulty: prior distributions are typically defined in the weight space of neural networks, whereas physically meaningful prior assumptions are more naturally expressed in function space. In this study, we introduce a unified framework, termed functional-prior-based approaches to Bayesian PDE-constrained inversion using physics-informed neural networks (fpBPINN), to incorporate functional priors into Bayesian PINN-based inversion. We consider two complementary approaches. The first is a functional-prior-informed Bayesian PINN (FPI-BPINN), in which a neural network weight prior is learned to be consistent with a prescribed functional prior, and Bayesian inference is subsequently performed in weight space. translated_title: 基于函数先验的物理信息神经网络贝叶斯偏微分方程约束反演方法
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）为求解偏微分方程约束的反问题提供了无网格框架，但其扩展到贝叶斯反演仍面临根本性困难：先验分布通常定义在神经网络的权重空间中，而物理上有意义的先验假设更自然地表达在函数空间中。在本研究中，我们引入了一个统一框架，称为基于函数先验的物理信息神经网络贝叶斯偏微分方程约束反演方法（fpBPINN），以将函数先验纳入基于贝叶斯PINN的反演中。我们考虑了两种互补的方法。第一种是函数先验信息贝叶斯PINN（FPI-BPINN），其中学习一个神经网络权重先验，使其与指定的函数先验一致，随后在权重空间中进行贝叶斯推断。第二种是函数空间粒子基方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过两种互补方法将函数空间先验有效融入贝叶斯PINN反演，解决了传统权重空间先验与物理意义不匹配的关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework that effectively incorporates function-space priors into Bayesian PINN-based inversion via two complementary approaches, addressing the key mismatch between weight-space priors and physical meaning.
